steps.title: Extract Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Extract gDNA from cells using lysis buffer and ethanol precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Re-suspend up to 1*10^7 cells in 500 μl of cell lysis buffer and incubate at 56 °C overnight (or 10-16 hr).
Add 500 µl of isopropanol directly into the microtube and mix by inverting until a genomic DNA pellet forms.
Transfer the DNA pellet to a new microtube containing 1 ml of 70% (vol/vol) ethanol.
Centrifuge at 13,000g for 5 min at 4 °C and discard the supernatant completely.
Dissolve the pellet in 200 µl of TE at 56 °C for at least 2 h.
Check concentration of a 1-μl aliquot with a NanoDrop (A260/280 >1.8) and adjust to 100ng/μl.

steps.title: Sonicate gDNA
steps.instruction: Fragment the gDNA using a Bioruptor in an amplicon-free environment.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 5 ug of gDNA to 100 ng/μl with water in a 1.5 ml microtube (final volume 50 μl).
If sample number is < 6, prepare 6-N tubes with 50 μl water.
Place tubes in a small metal holder with lid-knob in the Bioruptor.
Set device to LOW intensity and sonicate for 8 cycles of 30s ON and 90s OFF (Cold bath/system at 4 °C).
Verify fragment size by loading 500 ng (5 μl) of gDNA on a 0.8% agarose gel with a 1 kb Ladder; peak should be ~2 kb.
If peak is too high, add 2 cycles of sonication; if too low, restart with non-sonicated material.

steps.title: Perform Linear Amplification (LAM-PCR)
steps.instruction: Perform linear amplification using GXL-hotstart polymerase.

substeps.instruction: Calculate annealing temperature (Ta): If Tm > 55°C (using formula Tm = 2(NA + NT) + 4(NC + NG) - 5), set Ta to 60°C; otherwise, set Ta to 55°C.
Prepare reaction mix: 10 μl 5x GXL buffer, 4 μl 1x GXL dNTPs, 2 μl Bio-primer (1uM), 0.5 μl GXL-hotstart, 5 μl sonicated DNA (500ng to 100ug), and 28.5 μl water (Total volume: 50 μl).
Run PCR and clean up amplicons quickly to prevent ssDNA degradation.
For new primers, verify 5 μl of the reaction on a 0.8% agarose gel to ensure no exponential amplification occurred.

steps.title: Capture Biotinylated Products
steps.instruction: Capture linear amplicons using Streptavidin beads.

substeps.instruction: Prepare beads: Vortex Dynabeads C1 Streptavidin (10μg/μl) for 30 sec, transfer 20 μl to a tube, and add 600μl 1x B&W buffer.
Capture beads on magnet for 1 min, discard supernatant, and wash once more with 600μl B&W buffer (2x total wash).
Resuspend prepared beads in the linear PCR solution and mix on a mixer for 2 to 4 hours (or overnight).
Capture DNA-beads complex on magnet and wash 3x with 200 µl 1× B&W buffer.
Resuspend beads in 1 ml H2O, capture on magnet for 1 min, discard supernatant, and finally resuspend beads in 9 µl H2O.

steps.title: On-Bead Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Ligate bridge adapters to the 3' end of the linear amplicons.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Bridge adapters: Mix upper and lower oligos (400 uM) 1:1, heat at 100°C for 5 min, cool to RT, and dilute to 50 uM with water.
Wash DNA-beads complex 3x with 150 μl B&W (resuspend by pipetting), then wash 1x with 150 μl mQ and resuspend in 9 μl mQ.
Mix reagents: 10 μl 10x T4 ligB, 1 μl Bridge Adapt, 1 μl T4 DNA lig, 1 μl HexaCobalt, and 6 μl 50% PEG8000. Add the beads-DNA complex and mix thoroughly by pipetting (using cut tips).
Incubate for 1 hour (or 16 °C overnight). Do not spin before incubation. Resuspend the mixture after 2 hours of incubation to improve efficiency.

steps.title: On-Bead Adapter PCR
steps.instruction: Perform nested PCR to add Illumina adapter overhangs.

substeps.instruction: Wash ligation product: Add 20μl 2x B&W buffer, capture on magnet, wash 2x (resuspending between washes), wash 1x with 200μl water, and resuspend in 50μl water/TE buffer.

Prepare PCR mix: 10 μl 5x GXL buffer, 4 μl 1x GXL dNTPs, 2 μl I5-primer (10uM), 2 μl I7-primer (10uM), 0.5 μl GXL-hotstart, 5 μl sonicated DNA (500ng to 100ug), and 28.5 μl water (Total volume: 50 μl).
Note: Use only 2 μl (1/10th) of the ligation product per 50 μl reaction to avoid PCR inhibition by beads.
Purify reactions with 1.0x AMPure XP beads and elute in 25μl 1x TE.

steps.title: Nextera Indexing PCR
steps.instruction: Add indexing and flow cell binding sequences.

substeps.instruction: Prepare reaction mix: 10 μl 5x GXL buffer, 4 μl 1x GXL dNTPs, 2 μl I5-primer (10uM), 2 μl I7-primer (10uM), 0.5 μl GXL-hotstart, 5 μl sonicated DNA (500ng to 100ug), and 28.5 μl water (Total volume: 50 μl).
Use Indexing-N5xx and Indexing-N7xx primers.

steps.title: Quantify and Pool Samples
steps.instruction: Analyze size distribution and pool samples for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Option 1: Load products on 2% agarose gel with 100 bp ladder, gel extract desired size, quantify with Kappa Quantification Kit, and pool samples.

Option 2: Load products on 2% agarose gel with 100 bp ladder, determine peak length and molarity via GelAnalyzer (Area Under Curve method), pool equal molarity samples, gel extract desired size, check concentration with QuBit, and pool as desired.

steps.title: Demultiplexing and Informatics
steps.instruction: Convert raw data and filter reads.

substeps.instruction: Convert BCL to Fastq using BCL2FASTQ software with the .csv file method.
Filter for reads with the expected sequence in front of the primer binding site to check for mispriming.
